summary: No invented or wrong-direction conditions found; all SNOMED concepts exist and rule types, probable/possible levels and the Urgent priority match the box. Most consequential: the stroke/TIA facial-weakness branch only excludes upper facial weakness, so Bell's-type presentations also fire stroke/TIA; sinusitis and mumps ANDs are strict; and the allergen-exposure timing window and same-side shingles link are dropped. Management steps (oxygen, furosemide, drugs) and the rash/gum-tooth referrals are correctly not encoded as conditions.
